name: How long does a typical bathtub repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathtub repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of bathtub repair depends on the type of repair needed. Simple tasks such as replacing a faucet washer or re-caulking might take an hour or two. More involved repairs, like fixing a significant crack, replacing a drain assembly, or addressing hidden leaks, could take several hours or require a return visit for multi-stage processes such as curing. Alpha-Plumbing Services strives to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring quality workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies: an hour or two for simple fixes, several hours or multiple visits for complex issues like significant cracks or drain replacement.
